lanes.label: Parser fuzz harness (nightly)
lanes.evidence: `.github/workflows/fuzz-nightly.yml` runs `cargo fuzz run parse_input` for ≥ 1 hour on a nightly schedule against the `garnet-parser-v0.3/fuzz/` cargo-fuzz sub-workspace. The `parse_input` target wraps every call in a strict `ParseBudget` (4096-byte source cap, 1024-token cap, 32-depth cap, 512-byte literal cap), so neither CPU nor memory can be unbounded. Seed corpus is populated from canonical `examples/*.garnet` files; crashes upload as artifacts for triage. Closes the S5 surface gap.
